240-574-4885-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat from step 2.
240-574-4885-5470.notes: Depending on how many counters this combo puts on Vish Kal, you can activate its last ability to kill some number of creatures.

934-4881-6909-8199.manaNeeded: {1}{G}{W} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
934-4881-6909-8199.easyPrerequisites: Amorphous Axe is attached to Carnage.
934-4881-6909-8199.description:
Cast Brigid's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Myth Unbound

708-2210-2459-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Rograkh.
Choose to have Rograkh return to the command zone from your graveyard.
Myth Unbound and Mirrormade trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0} due to the cost reductions from Myth Unbound and Mirrormade.
Repeat.

728-4871-5220-7806.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
728-4871-5220-7806.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

586-864-2267-3125-6797.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-2267-3125-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Tormod.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Tormod trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

648-5879-6012.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is equal to or greater than the largest deck size among your opponents minus the number of +1/+1 counters on Walking Archive.
648-5879-6012.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to leave the battlefield.
648-5879-6012.description:
Cast Body of Research by paying {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U}, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token and then putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to your deck size.
Cause the Fractal to leave the battlefield by any method.
Reluctant Role Model triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters onto Walking Archive equal to the number of +1/+1 counters that were on Fractal.
At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, they will draw cards equal to the number of counters on Walking Archive. This should result in them drawing from an empty library either during their upkeep or their subsequent draw step, losing the game.

215-3043-4460.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures with defender.
215-3043-4460.description:
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Axebane Guardian from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Axebane Guardian by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

240-4875-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Conspiracy, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-4875-5231.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

3705-5231-6896-7422.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R} due to Green Goblin.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing Squee and the creature token, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-1387-1500-3940-5644.description:
Cast Haze of Rage with buyback by paying {R}. Birgi, Haze of Rage's storm ability, Blood Funnel and Judith trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Judith trigger, creating a 2/2 Imp creature token.
Resolve the Blood Funnel trigger, causing you to sacrifice the Imp.
When the Imp dies, it triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Haze of Rage trigger, copying it for each spell cast before it this turn.
Resolve all Haze of Rage spells.
Repeat.

803-1399-1606-4249.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least four.
803-1399-1606-4249.description:
Activate Nykthos by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Nykthos.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-1322-1563-2457.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating three 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

826-2198-3899-6243.notablePrerequisites: Amoeboid Changeling does not have summoning sickness.
826-2198-3899-6243.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, removing all creature types from Deceiver Exarch.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Deceiver Exarch.
When Deceiver Exarch dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Deceiver Exarch from your graveyard to the battlefield as an Angel with flying and a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Deceiver Exarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Amoeboid Changeling.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on it.
Repeat.

3200-4211-5660-5943.notablePrerequisites: One of the self-sacrificing artifacts must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
3200-4211-5660-5943.description:
Cast the self-sacrificing artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Ms. Bumbleflower triggers, causing an opponent to draw a card, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning the self-sacrificing artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the self-sacrificing artifact cast in step 1 by sacrificing it, and paying other costs if necessary.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2933-4499.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating six 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate three Eldrazi Scions by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1020-2866-4659-4814.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {C}{C}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {2}.
Mirrodin Besieged triggers, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Myr and Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {3}.
Mirrodin Besieged triggers, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Repeat.

2104-2499-2788-3634.notablePrerequisites: You haven't cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn.
2104-2499-2788-3634.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Double Vision triggers, copying Temporal Manipulation.
Holding priority, cast Venser by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Venser enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning itself and the original Temporal Manipulation to your hand from the battlefield and stack respectively.
Resolve the copy of Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2-140-2302.notablePrerequisites:
You have lost at least 4 life this turn.
Rowan does not have summoning sickness.
"Black" or "Red" chosen with Painter's Servant.
2-140-2302.description:
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn by at least {4}.
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {0} due to Rowan's ability.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3263-4027-4191.description:
Cast Glint Hawk without paying its mana cost.
Glint Hawk enters the battlefield, returning itself to your hand.
Repeat.

11-146-4872.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal, choosing to pay its replicate cost once, by paying a total of {U}{U}{U}{U}, targeting Time Warp.
Narset's Reversal's replicate ability triggers, creating a copy of it targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, creating a copy of the original Narset's Reversal targeting Time Warp and returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the second copy of Narset's Reversal, creating a copy of Time Warp and returning the original Time Warp to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

429-444-4067.description:
Activate Pristine Talisman by tapping it, adding {C} and causing you to gain 1 life.
Drogskol Reaver triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Pristine Talisman.
Repeat.

1167-2749-2770.description:
Cast Donate Giving control of Wall of Blood to an opponent.
Activate Mindslaver targeting that opponent.
Pass the turn.
Have your opponent activate Wall of Blood.
Repeat step 4.

305-1781-1978.description:
Cause Llanowar Tribe to become an artifact using Thran Forge.
Activate Llanowar Tribe by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Llanowar Tribe.
Repeat from step 2.

2468-3617.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers, casting a copy of Time Walk without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Time Walk, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
